name: Southland Center
summary: Southland Center is a community shopping destination in Corsicana, Texas, offering convenient retail and service options for local residents and visitors. With a 4.2-star rating, the center serves as a reliable hub for everyday shopping needs in Navarro County.
demographics: Southland Center serves the Corsicana community and surrounding Navarro County area, drawing primarily middle-income families and working professionals. The trade area reflects the demographics of this East Texas city of approximately 24,000 residents, with a mix of young families, retirees, and blue-collar workers employed in local manufacturing and oil industries. Shoppers tend to prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday necessities and practical retail options rather than luxury goods. The center attracts a loyal local customer base that values accessible shopping without traveling to larger metropolitan areas like Dallas, located about 55 miles north.
description: Southland Center serves as a vital community shopping destination in Corsicana, Texas, providing convenient retail and service options to residents of Navarro County and the surrounding East Texas region. Located at 200 North 15th Street, this shopping center has established itself as a reliable hub for everyday shopping needs in a city known for its rich history in the oil industry and as the home of the famous Collin Street Bakery. The center offers a practical mix of retailers and services that cater to the daily needs of local families, professionals, and visitors exploring this charming Texas town. With a solid 4.2-star rating from over 50 Google reviews, Southland Center has earned the trust and loyalty of the Corsicana community through consistent service and accessibility. Its strategic location makes it an essential stop for residents seeking quality shopping options without the need to travel to larger metropolitan areas.
